All original bash/Python/JSON fences remain byte-identical to the original reviewer source snapshot, and their dependencies retain the original inspected SHA. Reuses the original independently executed CPU audit (16 subprocesses), preserving its raw output and date; no command is claimed to have run again at checked_at. Four records cover the three Python examples and both comparison branches using existing fixed public weights. The comparison is not a re-run of the teaching width32 200/500-step recipe. No formal training, resume execution, GPU, cloud, downloads, generated guide notebook, or remote Colab validation. The new prose is independently re-read by the original factual reviewer and a separate full fresh novice.

from pathlib import Path

for kind in ("toy-text", "attributes-sft"):
    directory = Path("data/generated") / kind
    manifest = json.loads((directory / "manifest.json").read_text())
    print(kind, "seed", manifest["seed"], "切分單位", manifest["split_unit"])

        print(split, "筆數", stats["records"], "家族", stats["families"], "sha256", stats["sha256"])
        print((directory / f"{split}.jsonl").read_text().splitlines()[0])

seed_everything(42)
model = TinyLM(ModelConfig(width=32, layers=1, heads=1, max_length=128))
save_checkpoint(
    "checkpoints/start.pt",
    model,
    step=0,
    metadata={"seed": 42, "note": "untrained baseline"},
)
print("已保存起始模型；沒有求導或更新")

import json
import math
from pathlib import Path

kind = "attributes"
before = json.loads(Path(f"outputs/{kind}-before.json").read_text())
after = json.loads(Path(f"outputs/{kind}-after.json").read_text())
assert before["data"] == after["data"]
assert before["declared_split"] == after["declared_split"] == "validation"
assert before["effective_tokens"] == after["effective_tokens"] > 0
assert before["skipped"] == after["skipped"] == []
assert [s["row"] for s in before["samples"]] == [s["row"] for s in after["samples"]]
comparison = {}
for stage, report in (("before", before), ("after", after)):
    assert math.isfinite(report["mean_token_nll"])
    rate = report["exact_match"]
    assert rate is None or 0 <= rate <= 1
    comparison[stage] = {
        key: report[key] for key in ("mean_token_nll", "effective_tokens", "exact_match", "samples", "skipped")
    }
text = json.dumps(comparison, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
Path(f"outputs/{kind}-comparison.json").write_text(text + "\n")
print(text)
print("固定提示開始：", Path(f"outputs/{kind}-prompt-before.txt").read_text())
print("固定提示結束：", Path(f"outputs/{kind}-prompt-after.txt").read_text())

"""Verify current T.4 retains the exact programs actually executed in the original CPU audit."""
import hashlib
import json
import re
from datetime import UTC, datetime
from pathlib import Path
root=Path('/workspace/tiny-perceptron-vlm')
sha=lambda raw:hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
raw=(root/'course/training.md').read_bytes()
hs=list(re.finditer(rb'(?m)^## ([A-Z\d]+\.\d+) [^\r\n]+',raw))
i=next(i for i,h in enumerate(hs) if h[1]==b'T.4')
body=raw[hs[i].start():hs[i+1].start()]
old_path='docs/validation-artifacts/history/technical-revision-T.4-original-source-6c27cba4636bcba1ac1b93dd6c5cddcfd98638bab6b4d3965aa289568012e5a2.txt'
old=(root/old_path).read_bytes(); assert sha(old)=='6c27cba4636bcba1ac1b93dd6c5cddcfd98638bab6b4d3965aa289568012e5a2'
fences=lambda b:re.findall(rb'```(python|bash|jsonl|json)\n(.*?)```',b,re.S)
assert fences(body)==fences(old), 'Executable fences changed; actual new execution is required'
code_path='docs/technical-reviews/artifacts/T.4-cpu-audit-code.txt'
output_path='docs/technical-reviews/artifacts/T.4-cpu-audit.json'
code=(root/code_path).read_bytes()
output=(root/output_path).read_bytes()
audit=json.loads(output)
assert len(audit['runs'])==16 and all(r['returncode']==0 for r in audit['runs'])
assert audit['checks']['teaching_start']['step']==0
assert audit['checks']['teaching_start']['optimizer'] is None
assert audit['checks']['minimal_json_example']['effective_tokens']==7
assert abs(audit['checks']['minimal_json_example']['mean_token_nll']-5.97386714390346)<1e-7
report=json.loads((root/'docs/technical-reviews/T.4.json').read_bytes())
repo_sources={s['path']:s['sha256'] for s in report['sources'] if s['kind']=='repository_code' and not s['path'].startswith('course/')}
for path,expected in repo_sources.items():
 assert sha((root/path).read_bytes())==expected,(path,'Changed dependency invalidates the original execution')
py=[s.decode() for lang,s in fences(body) if lang==b'python']
assert len(py)==3
wanted=[('原 Python fence 1',py[0]),('原 Python fence 2',py[1]),('原比較練習：attributes；固定權重代替重訓',py[2]),('原比較練習：text；固定權重代替重訓',py[2].replace('kind = "attributes"','kind = "text"'))]
records=[]
for label,program in wanted:
 run=next(r for r in audit['runs'] if r['label']==label)
 records.append({'case':label,'program':program,'program_sha256':sha(program.encode()),'command':run['argv'],'exit_code':run['returncode'],'stdout':run['stdout'],'stderr':run['stderr'],'execution_origin':output_path,'executed_now':False})
receipt={'schema_version':1,'checked_at':datetime.now(UTC).isoformat(),'status':'passed','lesson_id':'T.4','source':'course/training.md#T.4','source_sha256':sha(body),'scope':'Current guide has only two prose corrections. All original bash/Python/JSON fences remain byte-identical to the original reviewer source snapshot, and their dependencies retain the original inspected SHA. Reuses the original independently executed CPU audit (16 subprocesses), preserving its raw output and date; no command is claimed to have run again at checked_at. Four records cover the three Python examples and both comparison branches using existing fixed public weights. The comparison is not a re-run of the teaching width32 200/500-step recipe. No formal training, resume execution, GPU, cloud, downloads, generated guide notebook, or remote Colab validation. The new prose is independently re-read by the original factual reviewer and a separate full fresh novice.','environment':audit['environment'],'result':{'total':len(records),'passed':len(records),'failed':0},'records':records,'repository_sources':repo_sources,'original_execution':{'source_snapshot':old_path,'source_sha256':sha(old),'program_path':code_path,'program_sha256':sha(code),'output_path':output_path,'output_sha256':sha(output),'accessed_on':audit['accessed_on'],'total_subprocesses':16},'verification_program':Path(__file__).read_text()}
p=root/'docs/validation-artifacts/technical-revision-T.4-guide-code.json'
p.write_text(json.dumps(receipt,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({'receipt':str(p.relative_to(root)),'source_sha256':sha(body),'reused_original_actual_programs':len(records),'new_training_runs':0}))
